articles.headline: WNBA's future is bright, but will Cathy Engelbert be there to lead it?
articles.description: Stakeholders around the league question whether Engelbert is the right person to lead the WNBA into the future.

images.name: Cathy Engelbert New York skyline dress [1296x729]
images.caption: Commissioner Cathy Engelbert raised eyebrows when she wore a dress featuring the Manhattan skyline to the deciding game of the 2024 WNBA Finals between the New York Liberty and the Minnesota Lynx in Brooklyn.

images.name: WNBA basketball commissioner Cathy Engelbert [1296x729]
images.caption: Since Cathy Engelbert was named commissioner in 2019, the WNBA has undergone a wave of expansion -- three new teams over the past two seasons, plus three more by 2030 -- after nearly two decades of stagnation at 12 franchises.

images.name: 100625 Cathy Engelbert and Napheesa Collier [1296x729] - Copy
images.caption: Two months after Cathy Engelbert presented Napheesa Collier the 2025 All-Star MVP trophy, the Minnesota Lynx star blasted Engelbert's leadership in her end-of-season exit interview.

images.name: Cathy Engelbert [1296x729]
images.caption: During Cathy Engelbert's tenure, the WNBA hit what she called "hypergrowth" mode, including new media rights deals worth $3.1 billion and league revenue that has grown almost tenfold.

images.name: Courtney Cronin criticizes WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert
images.caption: Courtney Cronin criticizes WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert
